items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: "See, Vic Gasper, Oak, you know, fellas like that, you know... Always had good musicians they did, you know."

ctx.x: Perrae, you too? Yeah, yeah, Perrae.

See, I never heard their band. They'd tell me they had fine bands, you know. I know most of the musical bands, you know. See, Vic Gasper, Oak, you know, fellas like that, you know, Piku, Teal, you know. Always had good musicians they did, you know. See, good reading musicians, you know. You get it? But all the band like Buddy Petit and Sam Morgan, they were a little tongue band. Celestane had a nice musical band. It was Ridley's band, you know. They had a nice musical band. Nice rhythm section, a little Chani on…
So those were some of the outstanding men on the instruments. Those were some of the outstanding men on the guitar players, banjo players, bass, drums.
